claude_result_text:
The current iteration had issues with the engine configuration of the Boeing-747, particularly in the spacing and definition of the four engines under the wings. The judge noted that they appeared as simple cylinders without clear pylon definition or plausible spacing.

I have made a targeted edit to `plane.js` to increase the outboard engine span (`zOffset`) from 22 to 26 units for both sides. This moves the outboard engines further toward the tips of the swept wings, improving the realistic proportions and inboard/outboard spacing required by the rubric (targeting an 8-10 score). I have kept all other structural and geometric parameters, including the pylon connections and wing sweep, unchanged to maintain assembly coherence as per the plateat guidelines. This edit focuses specifically on fixing one aspect of a known weak feature ('engines_four_underwing').
